plain: Control over the economy, the military or the government gathering in a very small group, in ways that are hard to undo.
eli5: One kid ends up with all the toys and makes all the rules, and nobody else can say no.
technical: AI-enabled concentration of economic, military or political power in a small group, potentially beyond the reach of elections, courts, markets and the need for many people's cooperation; pathways include coups, entrenchment by incumbents and economic dominance.
